It contains not more than 15% of hydroquinidine sulfate. Slightly soluble in water; soluble in boiling water and in alcohol; practically insoluble in acetone. A 1% solution in water has a pH of 6.0 to 6.8. Protect from light. USP 31 (Quinidine Sulfate). Fine, needle-like, white crystals, frequently cohering in masses, or a fine, white powder. It is odourless and darkens on exposure to light. It contains not more than 20% of hydroquinidine sulfate. Its solutions are neutral or alkaline to litmus. Soluble 1 in 100 of water, 1 in 10 of alcohol, and 1 in 15 of chloroform; insoluble in ether. Protect from light. Stability.
